positions.name: MeridianGateRationale
positions.frame: how did the Meridian release train arrive at its signed-manifest deployment gate?
positions.why: src-1 declares the gate requirement (signed manifest before shipping); src-2 supplies the motivating incident — two unsigned artifacts reaching staging last quarter. Together they trace the causal path from observed failure to enacted policy, read in the direction of why this gate exists.

positions.name: MeridianGateParameters
positions.frame: what are the operational parameters defining the Meridian deployment gate?
positions.why: src-3 names the gate requirement (signed release manifest), src-4 names the scope (staging and production), src-5 names the owner (Quinton Fairweather). Together they define the gate's operational boundaries — requirement, scope, and accountability — under one directional read of the decision's parameters.
